title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: OKX and NYSE Owner ICE Plan 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading Under SEC Exemption
summary: Filed under the SEC's new Innovation Exemption, the notice lists more than 60 stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, paired with stablecoins.

title: OKX, NYSE parent file to launch tokenized US stock platform
summary: The stock trading platform seeks to offer tokenized shares in more than 60 US-listed companies under the SEC’s recently introduced innovation exemption.

title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
summary: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’

title: OpenAI Banned PewDiePie Twice While He Built Ajax, an Uncensored AI That Will Run on Your PC
summary: The YouTuber says OpenAI suspended his account twice while he trained a small, uncensored model built to run on your own computer.

title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
